Third Party · Tailwind CSS

Tailwind is a utility-first CSS toolkit. You style by composing small classes in the template (flex, px-4, text-teal-700) instead of writing large custom SCSS files.

What it is

Build-time CSS: Tailwind scans your templates and emits only the utilities you used. It is not a set of Angular components — just classes.

bg-teal-700 text-white grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 rounded border p-3
